map.光子产生正负电子对所需最小能量。: Minimum photon energy required to produce an electron-positron pair.
map.📖 查看「电子对产生阈能计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View "Pair Production Threshold Calculator - User Guide"
map.需 ≥ 两电子静能之和。: Requires >= the sum of the rest energies of the two electrons.
map.γ 光子产生 e⁺e⁻ 的最低能量。: Minimum energy for a gamma photon to produce e+ e-.
map.探测器能量下限。: Lower energy limit of a detector.
map.>1.022MeV 的部分转为正负电子动能与反冲核动能。: The part above 1.022 MeV is converted to kinetic energy of the positron/electron and the recoil nucleus.
map.需同时创生电子与正电子，各静能 0.511MeV。: An electron and a positron must be created simultaneously, each with rest energy 0.511 MeV.
map.必须在核场附近？: Must it be near a nuclear field?
map.是；真空中需第三者（核）守恒动量，否则无法发生。: Yes; in vacuum a third body (nucleus) is needed to conserve momentum, otherwise it cannot occur.
map.靶核质量数 A（0=纯阈值）: Target mass number A (0 = pure threshold)
map.光子产生正负粒子对所需最小能量，可按轻子种类并计入靶核反冲。: Minimum photon energy to create a lepton pair, selectable by lepton species and including nuclear recoil.
map.⚠ 靶核质量数 A 须为 ≥0 的整数（0 表示不计反冲）。: ⚠ The target mass number A must be an integer >= 0 (0 means no recoil correction).
map.粒子对产生阈值：E_min = 2·m·c²（m 为所选轻子对单个粒子质量：电子: Particle-pair production threshold: E_min = 2·m·c² (m the mass of a single particle in the selected lepton pair: electron 9.10938356×10⁻³¹ kg, muon 1.8836485×10⁻²⁸ kg, tau 3.16745×10⁻²⁷ kg; c = 299792458 m/s)
map.核反冲修正（靶核质量数 A>0）：E_th = 2·m·c²·(1 + m/M): Nuclear recoil correction (target mass number A > 0): E_th = 2·m·c²·(1 + m/M), M = A×1.66053906660×10⁻²⁷ kg
map.联动量：阈值 eV = E_min ÷ 1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹、对应: Linked values: threshold in eV = E_min ÷ 1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹, corresponding photon wavelength λ = h·c ÷ E_min (m)
map.校验：靶核质量数 A 须为 ≥0 的整数（0 表示不计反冲）；判据：光子能量低于: Validation: the target mass number A must be an integer ≥ 0 (0 means recoil is ignored); criteria: photons below the threshold energy cannot produce that particle pair.
map.E_min = 2m c²：电子对约 1.022 MeV，μ 子对约 211.4: E_min = 2mc²: the electron pair is about 1.022 MeV, the muon pair about 211.4 MeV, and the tau pair about 3556 MeV.
map.靶核质量数 A>0 时计入核反冲，阈值略高于纯 2mc²。: When the target mass number A > 0, nuclear recoil is included and the threshold is slightly above the pure 2mc².
map.轻子对产生阈值仅取决所选粒子质量，与光子波长无关（波长由阈值反推）。: The lepton-pair production threshold depends only on the selected particle mass and not on the photon wavelength (the wavelength is back-solved from the threshold).
